descriptions.preferred: As the leaves unfold, they tend to droop, adding a softness to the plant's general appearance. Spring color is a soft yellow-green. The lobe tips are shaded with persimmon-red to light purple-red blends. Summer color is deep green, and fall color is crimson. The mediumsized leaves have five ovate lobes tapering to slender tips and separated halfway to the base. The margins are evenly and lightly toothed. This maple forms a rounded plant up to 10 ft. (3 m) tall and wide.

sources.title: 爪红—Acer palmatum 'Tsuma beni'
sources.description: 爪红最早的记录出现在 1882 年。在春天绿色的叶边缘 和叶尖会有明亮的紫红色，这种色彩可以一直持续到初 夏，在夏天叶子会转绿，秋天的色彩会有非常明亮的红 色。成年树高约 2.5 米。

rhs.description: A slow-growing, compact, rounded shrub or small tree with palmate leaves with 5-7 oval lobes, emerging yellow-green with red-purple tips to the lobes, turning darker green in summer and red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden, Flower borders and beds, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Architectural
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this amoenum group have large, palm-shaped leaves with finely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , pruning if necessary only from late autumn to midwinter
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting , softwood cuttings or layering

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

descriptions_zh.preferred: 叶片展开时常略向下垂，使整株外观更显柔和。春季叶色为柔和的黄绿色。裂片尖端带有柿红至浅紫红的混合色调。夏季转为深绿色，秋季则呈深红色。中等大小的叶片具五个卵形裂片，渐尖成细长尖端，自叶基向上约一半处分裂。叶缘均匀、轻微具齿。该枫树形成圆整株形，高和冠幅均可达 10 英尺（3 米）。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 生长缓慢，株形紧凑圆整，可形成灌木或小乔木。掌状叶具 5-7 个椭圆形裂片，春季展叶时为黄绿色，裂片尖端带红紫色，夏季转为较深的绿色，秋季变红。

attributes.suggested_uses: 城市/庭院花园、乡村/自然式花园、花境与花坛、低维护、露台/容器植物、结构型植物
attributes.hort_group_description: 此 amoenum 类群中的 Acer 品种具有大型掌状叶，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季必要时应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴晒过度都可能导致叶缘焦枯。参见日本枫树栽培资料。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有必要，仅在深秋至仲冬期间修剪
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接、嫩枝扦插或压条繁殖
